programChanges.title: Code-induced BSSC converse refinement
programChanges.objective: Convert the accepted finite-block code-induced structure into a rigorous BSSC converse that narrows or closes the sum-capacity gap, using a structure-preserving reduction, exact channel-consistency constraints, or a direct multiletter inequality.
programChanges.currentStateSummary: Every deterministic private-message code now has an accepted finite-block dependence-balance telescope, fixed-coordinate encoder-map factorization, and four compatible rate rows. An accepted finite entropic witness also proves that the specified coarse universal-entropy and finite-copy refinement cannot improve the classical UV value.
programChanges.localResidualSummary: Establish a valid compactness or support reduction preserving the full code-induced law, or derive exact binary-BSSC posterior constraints or a direct multiletter inequality; then perform and certify the resulting global converse optimization. The pruned coarse entropy/copy route is excluded.

withAccessAssessments.rationale: The estimate covers root-local work only: approximately 300 hours for independent achievability analysis, 450 hours for converse routes outside the code-induced package, and 150 hours for comparison, integration, limiting arguments, and final certification. It excludes every task assigned to the child program.

Conditional on pursuit, the estimate allocates about 120 hours to a structure-preserving compactness or support analysis, 160 hours to exact binary-posterior or direct multiletter constraints, 120 hours to rigorous global optimization and certification, and 80 hours to audit and contingency. Incidence is 0.6 because the accepted finite-block structure leaves credible channel-specific avenues, while the accepted witness decisively prunes the simpler universal entropy/copy route.

response.topologyRationale: The two accepted results are separately reusable but remain in one durable program: the entropy/copy no-go consumes the finite-block structure and prunes one refinement method within the same continue-or-prune converse decision. Their dependency order therefore does not justify separate accounting packages. The converse package is separated from root because evidence can independently activate, solve, reduce, or prune it, and it is placed directly under root because no narrower pre-existing activation gate exists.
